purpose: Read-only 479-record institution-first reconciliation audit; validates stored source-object and accession relationships without treating them as independently museum-verified physical artworks
methods: Select all IMPORT/IMPORT_WITH_CORRECTIONS records without confirmed 383 identity, excluding Commons-source rows (784 minus 305 = 479)
Verify internal source-object URL suffix and expected institutional domain using the frozen source metadata, not live museum pages
Compare normalized institution plus accession against all 2,455 frozen review cards (including rejects) for accession collisions
Cross-reference exact source IDs to the independent 281-record research candidate registry; do not inherit publication approvals
Retain text/title/artist and same-subject ambiguities as lead-only evidence; accession uniqueness does not independently establish separate physical artworks
